subject: Microsoft 365 recovers 📧, Claude joins meetings 🤝, AWS syncs secrets 🔑
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. The Microsoft cloud price change is not an AI model or API price list, so it is recorded as other/market_move.

stories.headline: Microsoft restores Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot after an outage running Thursday into Saturday
stories.quote: Microsoft says it restored service to all customers after an outage disrupted Exchange Online, Teams, Copilot, and other connected services from Thursday into Saturday.

facts.text: Outage ran from Thursday into Saturday (12 to 14 Nov).
facts.quote: disrupted Exchange Online, Teams, Copilot, and other connected services from Thursday into Saturday

facts.text: Servers failing automated health checks contributed; first recovery attempts did not give the expected relief.
facts.quote: Servers failing automated health checks contributed to the disruption, and initial recovery attempts failed to provide the expected relief.

stories.headline: Microsoft to raise commercial cloud prices 15.7% in India and 10% in New Zealand from 1 Jan 2027
stories.quote: Microsoft will increase commercial cloud prices by 15.7% in India and 10% in New Zealand starting January 1, 2027, citing currency adjustments.

facts.text: Commercial cloud prices rise 15.7% in India and 10% in New Zealand, effective 1 January 2027, citing currency adjustments.
facts.quote: Microsoft will increase commercial cloud prices by 15.7% in India and 10% in New Zealand starting January 1, 2027, citing currency adjustments.

facts.text: Prices fall in China, Australia and Norway; some on-premises products in India rise by up to 20%.
facts.quote: Prices will fall in China, Australia, and Norway, while some on-premises products in India face increases of up to 20%.

stories.headline: Anthropic rolls out Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise customers
stories.quote: Anthropic is rolling out Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise customers, letting Claude join Google Meet calls to answer questions, draft documents, and capture action items.

facts.text: Integrations planned with Granola, Gong, Attention, Fireflies.ai, Otter and Plaud.
facts.quote: Upcoming integrations with Granola, Gong, Attention, Fireflies.ai, Otter, and Plaud will let teams send meeting transcripts to their existing tools.

stories.headline: LMSYS launches SGLang Consortium with Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Google and Meta as founding members
stories.quote: LMSYS launched the SGLang Consortium to coordinate engineering work on its open-source AI inference engine, with founding members including Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Google, and Meta.

facts.text: Members contribute feedback, testing and development; SGLang maintainers keep control of technical decisions.
facts.quote: Members will contribute deployment feedback, testing resources, and development work, while SGLang's maintainers retain control over technical decisions.

stories.headline: AWS Secrets Manager adds cross-account replication
stories.quote: AWS Secrets Manager now supports cross-account replication, allowing teams to maintain synchronized copies of primary secrets across AWS accounts for backup, disaster recovery, and cross-account access.

stories.headline: GitHub to retire six Copilot models on 14 December
stories.quote: GitHub will retire six selected Copilot models on December 14.

facts.text: Six selected Copilot models are scheduled for retirement on 14 December.
facts.quote: GitHub will retire six selected Copilot models on December 14.
